text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Ahh... I thought I smelled the sea breeze.
Hello,
Teio.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wait, are you talking about me? Do I
smell like
that?!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
You do indeed, like an easterly wind
that blows
across the tides.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Is it really that strong?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
You're like a gale. It would be
impossible not to
notice.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
This is simply my guess, but I imagine
everyone at
school feels the same.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah, maybe it's because I was hanging
around
Golshi while she grilled all those
fish!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Aagh! What do I do?! I'm supposed to
meet Prez
after this! I can't go see her
stinking of fish!
